crossRefs.note: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,
The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow…

translations.web: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
translations.bsb: and to wear sandals, but not a second tunic.
translations.kjv: But be shod with sandals; and not put on two coats.
translations.asv: but to go shod with sandals: and, said he, put not on two coats.
